text_block_list.text: While researching something in the library, I heard a sorrowful voice coming from somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice can't... help them... I'm so sorry. I'm even bringing misfortune to the flowers...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Uu, fueeeh...! The poor flowers are going to...!
It seemed Rice Shower was growing flowers. However, because temperatures had been unusually high this year, she was worried they would wither before their time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Even though they bloomed so nicely... It's because Rice grew them that the weather went crazy...!
U-Um, excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-san...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I apologize for eavesdropping... but I wanted to recommend this magazine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, "Special Feature: Preserved Flowers"...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it allows you to preserve fresh flowers in their most beautiful state so you can enjoy them for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Remaining in eternal bloom without ever fading... it sounds just like a legendary flower from a storybook, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...With this, the flowers can stay blooming prettily forever...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Rob Roy-san! Rice wants to try this...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In that case, why don't we visit a trial workshop? There was an introduction to a class at the back of the magazine...!
Since the workshop required adult supervision, the two asked me to accompany them, and I agreed.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: To make preserved flowers, we take them at their peak freshness and perform bleaching and dehydration. This extracts the substances that cause them to wither.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: Today, we'll start processing the flowers right from where that preparatory step leaves off!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-All right. For the flowers' sake, I'll do my very best...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So this is the special solution that keeps flowers pretty... I have to handle it carefully...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Warm it up in the microwave until it's about body temperature, and then...
(POOF!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!? T-The liquid splattered everywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Awawawa, I have to remake the solution from scratch...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Little flowers, become pretty, become so pretty... Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Watching you do that makes it look like you're casting a spell.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eh, r-really? You think so?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Become pretty, become lovely. Sparkly, glossy, and super cute...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I did it!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: Great work, everyone! All that's left is to let them dry at home for about two days.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Now Rice can keep her own flowers pretty forever too...!
choice_data_list: I bet you're excited to make them on your own next!
I bet you're excited to make them on your own next!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now Rice can keep her own flowers
pretty forever too...!
choice_data_list: I bet you're excited to make them on your own next!
I bet you're excited to make them on your own next!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...! I-I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want Rob Roy-san to see it too. You're the benefactor who saved both the flowers and Rice...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Gladly...! I look forward to seeing your magical, eternally fresh flower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Rob Roy-san. Once it's finished, let's decorate our dorm room with it...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! I need to review everything when we get back so I don't forget...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'll help you. I made sure to memorize the procedure properly...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Rob Roy-san...! Rice will do her absolute best...!
Thinking of her flowers, Rice Shower smiled with a gentle warmth filled with hope.
